svg.aria-label: The everything app in layers. The Null Collateral Vault (nUSDC) backs many synthetics: rAAPL, rSPX, rBTC and rGOLD. Each synthetic has a long Morpho market (synthetic | nUSDC) and a short Morpho market (nUSDC | synthetic). The Null Savings Vault lends nUSDC into every long market, savers' deposits come from the Collateral Vault, and holders lend their synthetic into the short markets.
